title: Inverted condition for adding OPTIONS method
detail: The code adds the OPTIONS method when provide_automatic_options is False, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. This causes routes that should automatically provide OPTIONS responses to miss the OPTIONS method, and routes that should not provide it to incorrectly add it.
note: Says the condition is inverted: OPTIONS is added when the setting is off.

title: Inverted wait_ready check
detail: The server returns immediately when wait_ready() returns True (data available), but it should return only when the stream is closed (wait_ready() returns False). This causes the server to exit the request loop prematurely on normal data arrival.

title: Return of negative width value
detail: The cell table can contain a width of -1 to indicate a zero-width character. The previous implementation returned 0 in this case, but the new code returns the raw -1 value, which can propagate negative widths into rendering logic and cause incorrect layout or crashes.
